name: MonarchPricingSection
title: PricingSection
summary: A pricing band: a header, a billing period picker, one card per plan with its price, features and action, a note, and an optional feature comparison. Prices are shown exactly as given.
whenToUse: On a plans or upgrade screen that presents two to four plans with their features, and optionally compares them feature by feature.
whenNotToUse: For one plan, use MonarchPlanCard. For a comparison only, use MonarchPricingTable. An app that sells digital goods in an app store must follow that store's billing rules; this component only shows plans.
api: @Composable fun MonarchPricingSection(plans: List<MonarchPricingSectionPlan>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, title: String? = null, eyebrow: String? = null, description: String? = null, periods: List<MonarchPricingPeriod> = emptyList(), period: String? = null, onPeriodChange: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, comparison: List<MonarchPricingFeature> = emptyList(), note: String? = null, align: MonarchMarketingAlign = MonarchMarketingAlign.Center, tone: MonarchMarketingSectionTone = MonarchMarketingSectionTone.Default, comparisonTitle: String? = null, billingPeriodLabel: String? = null, action: (@Composable (plan: MonarchPricingSectionPlan) -> Unit)? = null)

class MonarchPricingSectionPlan(id: String, name: String, description: String? = null, prices: Map<String, String> = emptyMap(), price: String? = null, badge: String? = null, highlighted: Boolean = false, featuresLabel: String? = null, features: List<MonarchPlanCardFeature> = emptyList())

options.name: plans
options.description: The plans in display order: id, name, description, a price per period id, a fallback price, badge, highlighted flag, features label and features.

options.name: title
options.description: The title, read as a heading.

options.name: eyebrow
options.description: A short line above the title, in the accent.

options.name: description
options.description: The muted line under the title.

options.name: periods
options.description: Billing periods; with two or more the period picker is shown. priceSuffix and priceNote are shown with the price.

options.name: period
options.description: The chosen period id. null lets the section keep its own choice, starting with the first.

options.name: onPeriodChange
options.description: Called with the period id the user chooses.

options.name: comparison
options.description: Features compared by plan id, shown under the cards as a MonarchPricingTable grid.

options.name: note
options.description: A muted line under the cards.

options.name: align
options.description: The header centred or at the start edge.

options.name: tone
options.description: No fill, or the subtle background.

options.name: comparisonTitle
options.description: The heading of the comparison. null uses "Compare plans".

options.name: billingPeriodLabel
options.description: The spoken name of the period picker. null uses "Billing period".

options.name: action
options.description: The call to action of each plan, normally a full-width MonarchButton.

states.name: period chosen
states.description: Each card shows the plan's price for the period with the period's suffix and note.

states.name: fallback price
states.description: A plan without a price for the period shows its price, such as "Contact us", without suffix or note.

states.name: highlighted plan
states.description: The card has the accent border and an accent badge.

states.name: with comparison
states.description: "Compare plans" and a grid of features by plan follow the note.

appearance: The header uses the strong accent for the eyebrow, the default text for the title and the muted colour for the description. The picker is MonarchSegmentedControl, the cards MonarchPlanCard and the comparison MonarchPricingTable, each in its own roles. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web PricingSection lays the cards side by side on wide screens and shows the comparison table with prices and actions in its header. On Android the cards are stacked so each plan stays readable on a phone and at large font sizes, and the comparison is the MonarchPricingTable grid without prices, since the cards above carry them; its columns are at least 152dp wide (scaled with the font size) and the grid scrolls sideways when it does not fit, as the web table does. Feature items are MonarchPlanCardFeature (label, hint, included).
accessibility: The title and plan names are headings; the band is a traversal group.
The period picker is named "Billing period"; its segments are radio buttons with 48dp touch targets.
A feature that is not included is read with "Not included:" through MonarchPlanCard.
Comparison cells are read as the plan, the feature and the value.
edgeCases: A period id that is not in periods falls back to the first period.
Prices are text; nothing is calculated or formatted.
On a phone the comparison usually scrolls sideways; the feature column is not pinned.

examples.title: Plans with a period toggle and comparison
examples.setup:
var period by remember { mutableStateOf("monthly") }
var chosen by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
examples.code:
MonarchPricingSection(
    plans = listOf(
        MonarchPricingSectionPlan(
            id = "starter",
            name = "Starter",
            description = "For individuals getting organised.",
            prices = mapOf("monthly" to "₹A", "yearly" to "₹B"),
            features = listOf(
                MonarchPlanCardFeature("Up to 3 projects"),
                MonarchPlanCardFeature("Email support"),
                MonarchPlanCardFeature("Single sign-on", included = false),
            ),
        ),
        MonarchPricingSectionPlan(
            id = "team",
            name = "Team",
            description = "For teams that share work every day.",
            prices = mapOf("monthly" to "₹C", "yearly" to "₹D"),
            badge = "Recommended",
            highlighted = true,
            featuresLabel = "Everything in Starter, plus",
            features = listOf(
                MonarchPlanCardFeature("Unlimited projects"),
                MonarchPlanCardFeature("Single sign-on"),
                MonarchPlanCardFeature("Audit log"),
            ),
        ),
        MonarchPricingSectionPlan(
            id = "enterprise",
            name = "Enterprise",
            description = "For organisations with procurement and security reviews.",
            price = "Contact us",
            featuresLabel = "Everything in Team, plus",
            features = listOf(MonarchPlanCardFeature("Custom contract"), MonarchPlanCardFeature("Dedicated onboarding")),
        ),
    ),
    title = "Plans that grow with your team",
    eyebrow = "Pricing",
    description = "Placeholder prices for documentation; pass the prices your billing system publishes.",
    periods = listOf(
        MonarchPricingPeriod(id = "monthly", label = "Monthly", priceSuffix = "/ month"),
        MonarchPricingPeriod(id = "yearly", label = "Yearly", priceSuffix = "/ year", priceNote = "Billed yearly"),
    ),
    period = period,
    onPeriodChange = { period = it },
    comparison = listOf(
        MonarchPricingFeature(
            id = "projects",
            label = "Projects",
            values = mapOf(
                "starter" to MonarchPricingFeatureValue.Text("Up to 3"),
                "team" to MonarchPricingFeatureValue.Included,
                "enterprise" to MonarchPricingFeatureValue.Included,
            ),
        ),
        MonarchPricingFeature(
            id = "sso",
            label = "Single sign-on",
            group = "Security",
            values = mapOf(
                "starter" to MonarchPricingFeatureValue.NotIncluded,
                "team" to MonarchPricingFeatureValue.Included,
                "enterprise" to MonarchPricingFeatureValue.Included,
            ),
        ),
        MonarchPricingFeature(
            id = "contract",
            label = "Custom contract",
            group = "Security",
            values = mapOf("enterprise" to MonarchPricingFeatureValue.Included),
        ),
    ),
    note = "Prices shown before taxes.",
) { plan ->
    MonarchButton(
        text = when (plan.id) {
            "starter" -> "Choose Starter"
            "team" -> "Choose Team"
            else -> "Talk to sales"
        },
        onClick = { chosen = plan.id },
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        variant = if (plan.highlighted) MonarchButtonVariant.Primary else MonarchButtonVariant.Secondary,
    )
}
